title: Telecaller- Bhima Jewellery - Thirunelvelli
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Title: Telecaller
   

  

 Company Name: Bhima Jewellery Madurai
   

  

 Location: Thirunelvelli
   

  

 Salary: 1\.75\-3\.25 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Qualification: 0\-5 years of experience
   

  

**Job Description**
 Unlock a world of opportunities with Bhima Jewellery Madurai as a DEO/Telecaller/Greeter. Join our team and contribute to creating unforgettable customer experiences. With a salary range of 1\.75\-3\.25 Lacs P.A., this role is ideal for individuals with 0\-5 years of experience in data entry, telecalling, or customer service.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Perform data entry tasks with precision and accuracy.
   

  

 Engage with customers over the phone, providing information and assistance.
   

  

 Greet and assist customers visiting the showroom with a friendly demeanor.
   

  

 Collaborate with team members to enhance overall customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 0\-5 years of experience in data entry, telecalling, or customer service.
   

  

 Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry tasks.
   

  

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Customer\-centric approach with a positive and friendly attitude.
   

  

**FAQs**
 Q: What is the salary range for this position?
   

  

 A: The salary for the DEO/Telecaller/Greeter role at Bhima Jewellery Madurai is between 1\.75\-3\.25 Lacs P.A.
   

  

 Q: Are there growth opportunities within the company?
   

  

 A: Yes, Bhima Jewellery Madurai values employee development and provides opportunities for career advancement.
   

  

 Q: How can I apply for this position?
   

  

 A: You can submit your application through our official website or contact our HR department for further details.
   

  

 Q: Is there training provided for new hires?
   

  

 A: Yes, comprehensive training will be provided to ensure success in the DEO/Telecaller/Greeter role.
